Home.title_desription: Full-Stack web developer, Software engineer, and Game developer.
Home.description: My name is Thái Duy Vũ, and I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology. With two years of experience in full-stack web development, I have honed my ability to quickly learn and master new programming languages, frameworks, and libraries, regardless of the challenge. I am known for my cheerful and approachable nature, always ready to support my colleagues while maintaining a dedicated work ethic. I thrive on learning new technologies and continuously improving my skills, ensuring that I stay at the forefront of industry trends. While I tend to be more introverted and may find initiating conversations with strangers challenging, this trait allows me to focus deeply on my work and deliver meticulous results. I am confident that my technical expertise, proactive attitude, and commitment to excellence will make me a valuable asset to any team.
